simple.meaning: קַשָּׁת (qashshâth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a bowman.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קַשָּׁת (H7199) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קַשָּׁת (H7199) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קַשָּׁת (qashshâth) / H7199 is traced through Genesis 21:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H7199. qashshath קַשָּׁת noun masculine bowman (si versa l.); — ק ׳רֹבֶה וַיְהִי Gen 21:20 and he become, growing up, a bowman ; but ׳ר then superfluous (omitted by ᵐ5 ), after וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל v a ; Kn Di קָ֑שֶׁת רֹבֵה (= ק ׳רֹמֵה Jer 4:29 , which Ball reads here), compare Holz Gunk.

occurrences.englishText: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, became an archer.
